show.description: From rejection to revelation, a young man’s hunger for success turns obstacles into steppingstones. Defying betrayal and risking it all, he transforms failure into fortune. Witness the electrifying rise of the world’s youngest secret billionaire a story of grit, ambition, and destiny fulfilled.
